messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx error rate for inference endpoint `prod/gpt-serve` after artifact promotion at 1729993320. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/services/gpt-serve/errors. Auto-detected regression: tokenization errors + malformed responses.
oncall-maria: I'm on it, jumping into logs. tagging @sam-ml and @eng-runtime-lee. Any recent deploys?
sam-ml: I just promoted a new weight bundle and alias (`weights-prod -> weights/2026-03-15-9f2b`) ~2m ago as part of the model refresh. No tokenizer changes in that job, but the promo pipeline was modified yesterday.
eng-runtime-lee: seeing `ValueError: token id out of range: 65536` in worker logs and responses with garbled output (emoji inserted mid-token). Looks like the vocabulary mapping on the promoted artifact doesn't match the runtime tokenizer mapping.
oncall-maria: confirmed customer-facing errors reported via support for EU region (high traffic). Support, any examples? @support-paul?
support-paul: Customer ticket #2254: "responses contain random gibberish and <unk> tokens". Affects ~5 customers, elevated error rate in eu-west-1. Sharing example: `Model produced: \"hello \ud83d\udea9 world\"`
sre-jen: Recommend immediate mitigation: flip feature flag to stop auto-promotion/fallback and then rollback to previous weightset. Can we flip the kill-switch to prevent new requests routing to the mispromoted variant?
eng-runtime-lee: issuing flag now — command: ```rdctl feature-set --name=promote_auto_swap --env=prod --value=false --reason="hotfix: block mispromoted weightset"```
eng-runtime-lee: done — flag flipped. Confirming traffic still routed to problematic variant for existing connections but new routing should honor flag.
oncall-maria: thank you. Starting controlled rollback to previous artifact now. Sam — can you provide the last-good weightset sha?
sam-ml: last-good = sha:abc123def. Command to rollback on prod: ```rdctl rollout set model/gpt-serve --artifact=sha:abc123def --strategy=immediate --force --comment="rollback mispromoted weights"```
eng-runtime-lee: running rollback command now. ```> rdctl rollout set model/gpt-serve --artifact=sha:abc123def --force```
incident-bot: Rollout initiated: rollout_id r-2026-03-15-983. Progress: 0% -> 25% -> 60%
sre-jen: watching metrics. Increase in successful tokenizations starting at 60% — keep an eye on tail latency.
support-paul: customers reporting improvements for some requests, ticket updates sent.
incident-bot: Rollout complete. All nodes now on sha:abc123def. Error rate back to baseline.
oncall-maria: confirmed — error rate and garbled tokens resolved in eu-west-1. Reopening canary checks to validate artifact promo pipeline.
sam-ml: root cause: CI promotion job used alias `tokens-v2` that pointed to updated tokenizer mapping in staging, but weights were promoted from a different build — mismatch introduced by a race in the promotion step. Will open PR to add validation: ensure tokenizer hash matches weightset hash on promo.
eng-runtime-lee: creating an emergency hotfix to add a pre-promotion check and fail the promo if tokenizer mismatch detected. Patching pipeline now.
sre-jen: postmortem owner: @sam-ml. Action items: (1) add pre-promo validation, (2) add canary-level token consistency check, (3) tighten prod promo permissions.
oncall-maria: customer impact: medium (partial customer errors, degraded responses) — support notified all impacted customers and provided rollback update.
sam-ml: I'll follow up with a timeline for the PR and tests.
eng-runtime-lee: moving to monitoring mode. If anything else pops up ping #incidents. :white_check_mark:
